schemaVersion.description: Schema compatibility version. Unknown versions require an explicit future migration.

supportMode.description: Support objective: auto uses geometry readiness; optimized compares actual native alternatives; easy_remove favors contact removal; stable favors support robustness; off disables supports explicitly.
supportMode.x-defaultBehavior: Optional; when absent legacy supports true means auto and false means off. An explicit mode takes precedence.
supportMode.x-commonMistake: Do not infer a machine capability from a similarly named model.
supportMode.x-safety: Verify values against the exact hardware and firmware before printing.

supportStyle.description: Native support structure. Auto permits supported native style comparison; organic, snug and grid select explicit native styles.

supportPlacement.description: Everywhere can anchor on lower model geometry; buildplate restricts supports to bed-connected placement and can leave internal overhangs unsupported.

supportPlacement.x-safety: Verify values against the exact hardware and firmware before printing.

supportAngle.description: Overhang slope threshold from the horizontal plane. Higher thresholds include steeper faces and can request more support. This is not an angle measured from vertical.
supportAngle.x-defaultBehavior: Optional; omitted means 45 degrees. Internal Go zero value is normalized to 45; explicit JSON values must be 20 through 80.
supportAngle.x-commonMistake: Do not infer a machine capability from a similarly named model.
supportAngle.x-safety: Verify values against the exact hardware and firmware before printing.
